name: Dwarven Plate
summary: Plate armor that adds +2 to AC and lets you resist being moved.

stats.effect: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to {ref:glossary/armor-class}. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a {ref:glossary/reaction} to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.
